description: Versioned, voteable data-layer schema for the Dimensions RPG (chaosD6). Every entity (rule, effect, skill, class, character, creature, item, etc.) is a VersionedEntry. Governance = Radicle git branches propose new versions, peers sign votes, a rebalance pass updates weights, and the engine loads the highest-weight canonical version at session start.

entry_contract.id: stable kebab-case id, unique across the collection; never reused
entry_contract.collection: which top-level file this entry lives in (see index.json collections)
entry_contract.name: human-readable name
tags: optional free-form tags used by the rebalance script to find related entries

versions.version: semver-ish string; v1.0.0 is the paper-rules original
versions.weight: float in [0.0, 1.0] — current consensus confidence; the engine picks the highest-weight non-rejected version at session start
versions.status: canonical | proposal | superseded | rejected | resolved (contradictions only)
versions.origin: paper_rules | player_vote | rebalance_script | fork_merge | playtest_patch | runtime_contract
versions.author_peer_id: Radicle peer id of the proposer; empty for paper_rules
versions.parent_version: the version this one derives from, or null if root
rebalance_links: list of entity ids that are mechanically coupled; if the rebalance script bumps this entry it will propose counter-balance deltas on these

vote_log.weight_contribution: float; signed to add/subtract from weight

versions.notes: optional free-form rationale from the proposer
versions.data: the actual mechanical payload; shape depends on the collection

collection_shapes.effects: data = { element_cost:[element_id], effect_types:[damage|instant|point_buy|permanent|channeling|stat_buy|shield_token], text, dispelable_by:[entry_id], every_bonus (for ∀ doubled casts) }
collection_shapes.classes: data = { colors:[element_id], ability_kind: once_per_round|static|tap, text, destroy_cost:'point-buy each color at value 6' }
collection_shapes.actions: data = { code:A|B|M|P|EP|EM, text, rps_wins_against:[action_code], rps_loses_against:[action_code], can_cast_non_instant_effects:bool }
collection_shapes.characters: data = { combo:[action_code], adept_element, stats:{vitality, world, matter, will}, life:int, actions_per_round:int }
collection_shapes.creatures: data = { stats:{...}, life:int, actions_per_round:int, dice_pattern:'BAAPM|AAAM|BMAP', innate_effect:effect_id, on_action_rider:{action_code, bonus_damage} }
collection_shapes.game_modes: data = { tileset_size, player_count, win_condition, time_per_turn_s, special_rules_text }
collection_shapes.contradictions: data = { source_entries:[entry_id], description, evidence:[...], proposed_resolutions:[{resolution_id, text}], chosen_resolution? }
collection_shapes.sync_protocol: data = free-form protocol parameters per entry (tiers, phases, intervals, flows, algorithms); numbers are the tunables the community votes on
collection_shapes.hashgraph_events: data = { scope: dimension|door|strong_region, emitted_by, finality, payload:{field: type-description} }
collection_shapes.dimension_session: data = { shape: {field: type-description} } describing dimension.json / doors/<DoorId>.json / local client state
collection_shapes.governance: data = free-form per entry: branch layout, voting thresholds, rebalance script contract, fork policy, write permissions

sync_contract.description: How the data layer participates in the P2P / Radicle / hashgraph sync model.
sync_contract.write_boundary: The engine NEVER mutates versions in place. All changes land as a new version appended to `versions`. The highest-weight non-rejected version is the active one at a given turn.
sync_contract.merge_strategy: git merge is additive on the `versions` array; conflicting metadata on the same version (same id+version) picks the higher weight.
sync_contract.rebalance_cycle: A deterministic script walks `rebalance_links`; a buff above tolerance proposes equal-magnitude counters on linked entries; proposals go to proposals/<entry_id>-<ts>.
sync_contract.votes_in_dimension_vs_global: A player's vote weight on an entry is scaled by their time-of-use with that entry inside their owned Dimension; measured from session telemetry.
